note: Provider-neutral lexicon. `spoken` is a plain-text alias any TTS can read (the publication voice, ElevenLabs Multilingual v2, takes aliases only); `ipa` is optional for providers that accept phonemes. Captions, on-screen copy, and the spec always use display text, never aliases. A changed entry is a new `version` (src/narration/lexicon.ts pins each one); the id stays, so a pronunciation change never moves the spec. Add an entry only for a term a script speaks and a listen or recognizer check shows the voice gets wrong.
